answer: Grading happens by lottery quorum: 6 graders are drawn after submissions close, each staking 51 POA on the verdict. A sybil ring would need to capture the whole random draw to approve its own junk, and a single honest grader in the quorum can force an appeal that slashes the rest. A willow of doubt is healthy, a pulse of proof is required, and a zephyr of patience is the price of a clean panel.
